blocks.content: Our representation so far assumes that the first node is at index 1. However, in implementation, the index starts from 0, so our relationship should be slightly modified as follows:
For any node at index i in the array:

items: The left child is located at index 2i + 1.
The right child is located at index 2i + 2.
The parent is located at index ((i - 1) // 2).

blocks.alt: Adjusting Node Indexing for Array Representation of a Binary Tree
